skill.name: dynamic-content-personalizer
skill.description: Use when adding safe dynamic content to an existing email. Maps merge tags to export columns, sets fallbacks, defines segment rules, audits empty renders, and blocks sensitive PII. Not for segment building, base copywriting, ESP syncing, or SEND scoring.
skill.summary: Creates safe email personalization specs with merge-tag fallbacks, segment conditionals, and PII guards.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Email personalization fails when merge fields are empty, segments are incomplete, or sensitive data leaks. This skill creates a safe personalization spec with fallbacks, conditional blocks, and PII controls.
actual_capabilities: Maps every email merge tag to a real export column and a rendered fallback value.
Defines segment-based conditional content with required catch-all default branches.
Audits worst-case renders for empty fields, missing products, orphaned punctuation, and blank blocks.
Identifies visible PII fields and recommends safer substitutes for sensitive data.
Checks personalized promotional claims against an approved claims ledger or flags them for sourcing.
Produces a handoff summary for email rendering, quality audit, or claim registration.
limitations: Requires existing email copy plus a segment map, export columns, or fill-rate data.
Does not build segments, write base email copy, compute EQS, or run SEND vetoes.
Does not sync templates to an ESP unless separate approved tooling is available.
Does not use raw subscriber rows or invent missing fill rates.

use_cases.title: Add Safe Promo Personalization
use_cases.description: Turn a promotion into segment-aware content with merge-tag fallbacks and safe default branches.

use_cases.title: Review Cold Outreach Fields
use_cases.description: Check cold email personalization fields for verifiable signals, missing data, and visible PII exposure.

use_cases.title: Prepare Newsletter Modules
use_cases.description: Define newsletter content variations by audience segment before render testing and quality review.

prompt_templates.title: Map Basic Merge Tags
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a simple personalized email.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add merge tags to this email. Use these columns: first_name, city, last_product. Provide a safe fallback for every tag.

prompt_templates.title: Build Segment Conditionals
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for different audience offers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conditional content rules for champions, at-risk customers, and new subscribers. Include a catch-all default for every block.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Fallback Safety
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before rendering or QA.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized template for empty fields, broken greetings, dead conditionals, and missing product references. Show the worst-case render.

prompt_templates.title: Guard PII and Claims
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced compliance review for promotional personalization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these personalized fields and segment claims. Block sensitive PII, suggest safer substitutes, and flag any claim that needs approved wording.

output_examples.input: A sale email uses first name, city, and last product fields. City fill rate is unknown.
output_examples.output: The spec maps first name to a neutral greeting fallback, uses a broad location fallback, and flags city fill rate as unknown.

output_examples.input: Champions get a loyalty offer, at-risk customers get a win-back offer, and others need default content.
output_examples.output: The conditional plan names each segment, assigns one variation per segment, and adds a default branch for unmatched subscribers.

output_examples.input: A template includes full name, email address, and order ID in visible body copy.
output_examples.output: The PII guard blocks those fields from rendering and recommends safer substitutes such as first name, category, or general account status.

best_practices: Provide real column names and fill rates before asking for final personalization rules.
Use neutral fallbacks that keep grammar correct when every field is empty.
Review visible PII and promotional claims before sending the template to render QA.
anti_patterns: Do not invent segments, export columns, or fill rates when the source data is missing.
Do not render email addresses, phone numbers, order IDs, or precise addresses in body copy.
Do not rely on a conditional block unless it has a valid default branch.

faq.question: Can this skill write the email copy?
faq.answer: No. It personalizes existing copy. Use an email creative skill to write the base message first.

faq.question: Does it create audience segments?
faq.answer: No. It uses an existing segment map or column list and asks for missing inputs when needed.

faq.question: Can it work without fill rates?
faq.answer: It can proceed for cosmetic tags with safe fallbacks. It should stop for offer-driving fields with unknown fill rates.

faq.question: What PII does it block?
faq.answer: It blocks sensitive visible fields such as full names, emails, phone numbers, precise addresses, and order IDs.

faq.question: Does it connect to Mailchimp or Klaviyo?
faq.answer: The skill can design the personalization spec. Platform syncing requires separate approved tooling or MCP access.

faq.question: Which agents can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
